title: Businesses on the way to somewhere
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What have you started that you cannot yet explain to anyone?

groups.heading: Businesses on the way to somewhere

lines.text: Jose said it is amazing that the person ended up with a satellite internet business as a consequence of the overall mission of colonizing another planet. Sometimes you find businesses on the way to somewhere.
A student said his old partners say: that's how he does things. He has a crazy idea, and then he figures out how to back-fill it as a legitimate business.
Jose said that people who are mission-driven don't care about losing money for three or four years, because they know it will come out in the end.

He told of a friend who took him to the window of his office and pointed at the middle of the ocean. A hundred or two hundred metres out, he said, I'm going to do a landfill, the first man-made islands in this hemisphere.

He had no marketing study and no consultants, Jose said. He did sixty acres of man-made islands and a marina between them. It was a total success after two or three years of hardship, and now I drive on the islands and think: I know this guy.

A student said: if you can get punched in the mouth every day for two or three years and then accept the payoff, that is how I would put it. I've got this thing I can't explain why it's gonna work, but I know it will. We might lose every dime for two years.

Jose said you have to stick to your guns. Investors normally want a return in three to five years, he said, which rules out a lot of businesses. Even a restaurant needs twelve to fourteen months to stabilize.
What are you building that needs more time than an investor wants to give?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the mission behind what you do.
Write the business you may find on the way.
Write how long you can go without profit.
Write what an investor who wants a return in three to five years would ask.
Write what you would say to yourself in year two.

check.q: What did Jose say about mission-driven people and losses?
choices: They don't care about losing money for a few years

check.q: What did a student say about the person's way of working?
choices: He has a crazy idea and back-fills a business

check.q: How long did Jose say a restaurant needs to stabilize?

recap: Keep to the mission. Businesses may be found on the way. Know how long you can wait.
